QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Peer-Reviewed Research
QuestInfo.0: Becky gives you a rundown of what she's learned from the research you've been helping her with. She confessed to you that the research team was soon to face dire budget cuts, but that their head scientist, Dr. Jang, has vowed to carry on with the team's mission anyway. You hope there's a bright future in store for these stalwart ladies.
